calibration.gate_rule: Gaussian H0: |mean V_stoch| < 5% of the noise floor AND T1/T2 rejection at alpha=0.05 no worse than 0.20 across 100 reps. The Student-t row is not gated; it quantifies how much fat tails alone inflate V_stoch, which is exactly why the conservative floor exists.
